## Known architecture constraints (project-level)

- **Monolithic Magento 2.4.8-p5 + Hyvä frontend** — single storefront, Tailwind v4, Magewire 1.13.
- **Local-dev only config:** `env.php` = `MAGE_MODE` developer, file cache + file sessions.
  Production BẮT BUỘC cấu hình Redis (cache + sessions) + Varnish (FPC) + OpenSearch. `[TBD]`
- **Search engine chưa cấu hình** — Magento 2.4.8 yêu cầu OpenSearch ở production. `[TBD]`
- **Single-store (assumed)** — scope là DB-only; `launchpad_fashion` theme + `development_fashion`
  branch gợi ý có thể có 2nd store → `[TBD — confirm multi-store intent, blueprint §14]`
- **Mageplaza modules committed as source** (không composer) — version drift / update path cần quản lý.
- **RabbitMQ chưa cấu hình** — async B2B/message queue không available.

## High-risk areas (blueprint §12)

- `Secomm_VNPAY` — custom payment gateway (IPN validation, signature, default inactive).
  Cần enable + security review trước go-live.
- Mageplaza One Step Checkout — flow phức tạp thay default checkout; risk payment/address interaction.
- `Secomm_AddressDropdown` + `VietNamAddress` — custom address capture + data import; risk data quality + GraphQL surface.
- Production infrastructure undefined — chưa có Redis/Varnish/OpenSearch/CI trong repo.
